items.statement: The submitted calculation preserves the neutral C4H7 doublet identity and documents geometry, methods, per-state character and sensitivity.
items.expected: Explicit identity, provenance, validation and per-state evidence.

items.statement: The six-state spectrum contains a weak near-window n→π* state and a brighter shorter-wavelength n→3s Rydberg state.
items.expected: Six state results and method-dependent comparison support this pattern.

items.statement: Low-energy-peaked, isotropic H-atom products support internal conversion and statistical ground-state dissociation.
items.expected: The interpretation compares this evidence with prompt dissociation and states limits.
